name: Flower City Feeling Good Wednesday Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, late May to early October. Gather 5:30 pm, roll 6:00 pm in September and October (7:00 pm roll in May to August). A different start each week at a city recreation center or park. The last ride on the calendar is Oct 7, from Schiller Park.

start_location.name: A different Rochester recreation center or park each week (Oct 7: Schiller Park, 350 Andrews St)

host.name: Reconnect Rochester, with the City of Rochester Recreation Department and EE Pathways

visitor_notes: Helmets required, bikes not provided. Get there by 5:30 pm and R Community Bikes will check that your bike is rideable. You need to be able to hold a steady pace. Check the calendar for each week's start.
description: A free guided ride for the City of Rochester Recreation Department, led by Reconnect Rochester. Each week is about 7 miles on a different route and shows how the city's bike boulevards link neighborhoods. The pace is easy but steady, and the ride is over in about an hour.
evidence: Reconnect Rochester's public community calendar lists the ride for Wed Sept 30 and Wed Oct 7, 2026 (Schiller Park, 'Gather at 5:30pm for a prompt 6pm roll-out'), and its weekly-rides page says rides leave at 7 pm May to August and 6 pm in September and October (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The community calendar feed carries each week's start. The series stops after Oct 7 and comes back in late May.

name: FLCC Thursday Group Gravel Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm, weather permitting. The start changes each week (often the Shindagin MTB trailhead or the Danby Park'n'Ride lot) and is emailed earlier that week.

start_location.name: Varies by week; announced on the FLCC-Gravel Google Group

pace: Two groups, one relaxed and one moderate
visitor_notes: Sign up for the FLCC-Gravel Google Group to get the week's start and any cancellation. Bring blinking lights, water, a helmet and flat-repair gear. Tires wider than 700x33c at 60 psi or less are a good start. Heavy rain, thunder and high wind cancel it.
description: Gravel and dirt roads around Ithaca on Thursday evenings. A typical ride is a loop of about 20 miles with about 2,000 feet of climbing, split into a relaxed group and a moderate group. The host says it is no-drop and all skill levels are welcome.
evidence: FLCC's events feed and event page list the FLCC Group Gravel Ride for Thu Oct 1, 2026, 6:00 to 8:00 pm, 'Rides are no-drop and start at 6pm' (fetched Oct 1, 2026); the club's gravel page links to a Sept 24 event too.

refresh.notes: The feed lists the next ride only; later Thursdays go up week by week. The gravel page still says '2025 season' in its text.

name: FLCC Saturday Social Ride
schedule: Saturday mornings, May to September (10:00 am on the events feed), meeting place announced each week. Back in May 2027 if it follows the same pattern.

start_location.name: Announced each week on the FLCC Google Group

visitor_notes: Bring water and a helmet, and a bike in good mechanical shape. Rain dates may be Sunday mornings. Details and meeting places go out each week through the FLCC Google Group; the coordinators are named on the club page.
description: Moderately paced social road rides for intermediate riders, with a social stop most weeks. Rides run 25 to 35 miles and get longer through the season. The host says no-drop: the group regroups at the tops of big hills and at busy intersections.
evidence: FLCC's event page lists the FLCC Saturday Social Ride for Sat Sept 26, 2026, 10:00 am to 2:00 pm, and says social weekend rides run May to September (fetched Oct 1, 2026); nothing is posted after that date.

refresh.notes: Check the events feed in late April for the 2027 start.

status_note: Host runs these social weekend rides from May to September. The last one on the events feed was Sat Sept 26, 2026. No 2027 date posted.

name: OCC Saturday and Sunday Club Rides
schedule: Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 am, a different ride and start each weekend on the club calendar. Saturday rides are shorter and flatter; Sunday rides are the longest and hilliest. Several October dates still say 'Leader needed'.

start_location.name: Varies by ride; see the OCC ride calendar and its ride start locations page

pace: Rated on the calendar for each ride, with shorter options on most
cost: free for a first guest ride, then OCC membership
visitor_notes: The club's Tuesday-ride page says guests may ride once before joining; ask the leader. Rides are not usually cancelled for weather. Spring and fall rides are shorter and flatter. Check that a leader is listed before you drive out.
description: The Syracuse club's weekend road rides. The calendar lists a named ride with a code, a time and a start each weekend, from Cazenovia to Fayetteville and the Erie Canal. Saturday is the easier day and Sunday the long one.
evidence: OCC's ride calendar lists rides at 10:00 AM on Sat Oct 10, Sun Oct 11, Sat Oct 17, Sun Oct 18, Sat Oct 24, Sun Oct 25 and Sat Oct 31, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026); most still say 'Leader Needed'.

refresh.notes: The month view lists each ride with its time and leader status. Winter weekend rides are not described on the site.

name: MHCC Sunday Morning Wake Up Ride
schedule: Sundays, 8:00 am 'for the rest of the riding season', per the Oct 4 listing. Start and route are posted on the club schedule.

start_location.name: Given by the ride leader; use 'Contact Leader' on the MHCC ride listing

cost: free for one non-member ride, then $20 a year in club dues
visitor_notes: Non-members use 'Contact Leader' on the ride listing to say they are coming, and the leader gives the start and the route. Sign the waiver at the start and arrive 15 minutes early.
description: A Sunday morning road ride from the Mohawk Hudson Cycling Club, about 23 miles at a 12 mph pace. The Oct 4 ride climbs to the Thacher Park escarpment and stops at Stewart's in Altamont for a warm drink. The leader says all are welcome.
evidence: MHCC's public ride schedule lists the Sunday Morning Wake Up Ride for Sun Oct 4, 2026 at 8A (Sport/12, 22.5 miles) and says '8:00am start time for the rest of the riding season' (fetched Oct 1, 2026); no later Sundays are posted yet.

refresh.notes: The schedule shows about two weeks ahead. Leaders post each week's ride.

name: MHCC Women on Wheels (WOW) Rides
schedule: Weekend mornings, posted one ride at a time on the MHCC schedule. Next: Sun Oct 4, 9:30 am (Kinderhook bagels, 23 miles, back to Nassau) and Sat Oct 10, 11:00 am (Hudson Falls to Lake George, 26 miles, from Murray Park).

start_location.name: Different each ride; Oct 10 starts at Murray Park, Hudson Falls

cost: free for one non-member ride, then $20 a year in club dues
visitor_notes: Women only. Bring a friend or a sister if you like; tell the leader ahead so she can take emergency contact details and register her. New riders must tick the waiver box online or no registration goes through. Time is on each ride listing.
description: Women-only rides from the Mohawk Hudson Cycling Club, on paved rail trails and quiet roads with a coffee or bagel stop. The host says the rides are meant to be safe, non-competitive and judgement free, to build the women's community in the club.
evidence: MHCC's public ride schedule lists WOW rides for Sun Oct 4, 2026 (9:30A, Casual/10) and Sat Oct 10, 2026 (11A, Casual/10), both described as for women only (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Rides appear about two weeks ahead, with the title starting 'WOW' or 'Women on Wheels'.

name: Hudson Valley Rail Trail Riders Weekend Rides
schedule: Most Sundays at 10:30 am and some Saturdays (the next one is Sat Oct 3, 11:00 am, Maybrook Trail South, about 22 miles). The trail and meeting place are on each Meetup event, which is visible to members.

start_location.name: A different rail trail each ride across Dutchess, Orange, Ulster and Columbia counties

pace: 22 to 26 miles, easy, mostly paved rail trail

host.name: The Hudson Valley Rail Trail Riders (Meetup)

visitor_notes: Join the Meetup group to see each ride's meeting place. Most trails are paved; the Wallkill Valley, Hurley, Hudson Electric and Stewart Buffer Lands trails mix crushed stone and packed dirt, so a hybrid or mountain bike is more comfortable there than a road bike.
description: A Meetup group that rides the rail trails of the mid-Hudson Valley: the Maybrook Trail, Harlem Valley, Ashokan, Orange Heritage and the Dutchess Rail Trail over the Walkway. Rides run 22 to 26 miles at an easy pace, mostly on weekends. The trail, the day and the start change from ride to ride.
evidence: The group's Meetup events page lists rides on Sat Sept 19, Sat Sept 12, Sun Sept 6 and Sun Aug 30, 2026 and an upcoming ride on Sat Oct 3, 2026 at 11:00 am (fetched Oct 1, 2026); event details are members-only.

refresh.notes: Meetup's calendar feed now needs a signed link, so the events page is the one to read.

name: RBC Weekend Supported Rides
schedule: Saturdays and Sundays, 9:00 am, April to November (the supported rides, marked SR on the calendar). A different route and start each weekend. The start is visible to members of the RBC Meetup group.

start_location.name: Different each ride; shown on the RBC Meetup event to members

pace: Supported rides (SR): 10 to 12 mph average, the leader rides at the back
cost: free to try as a guest; club dues after
visitor_notes: The ride leader carries extra maps for non-members. The Meetup group is private: ask to join and read the waiver first, then the start shows on each event. You need to be able to ride about 2 hours at 10 to 12 mph over some rolling terrain.
description: The Rochester Bicycling Club's slower weekend rides, marked SR for supported ride. The leader stays at the back, gives safety tips and the group regroups as it goes. The club also runs weekday evening rides through the summer, with a 5:30 pm Wednesday ride listed for Oct 7.
evidence: The RBC Meetup events page lists SR rides at 9:00 AM on Sat Oct 3 (Hamlin Hustle), Sun Oct 4 (Summer Breeze), Sat Oct 10, Sun Oct 11, Sat Oct 17 and Sun Oct 18, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026); start locations are members-only.

refresh.notes: Titles and times show without joining; the start does not. The club says weekend rides run April to November.
